subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is exactly one Tom-like blue-gray cartoon cat character defined by <Picture 1>. Preserve the large triangular pink inner ears, blue-gray fur, white muzzle, white paws, white belly patch, yellow-green eyes, black nose, long whiskers, expressive black eyebrows, oversized cartoon head, compact torso, and classic 2D cel-animated outline style. The four views in <Picture 1> are alternate identity views of the same single physical character, not separate characters. Keep stylized cat anatomy. Do not give the character a human face, human hands, human fingers, or realistic human body proportions.
<Subject 2> is the original female performer in <Video 1>, used only as the source for exact body motion, staff choreography, head movement, gaze direction, expression timing, balance shifts, and pose transitions.
<Subject 3> is the traditional Chinese courtyard environment from <Video 1>, including the white walls, dark carved roof edges, grey stone paving, ornamental windows, bonsai trees, stone railings, and overcast blue-gray daylight.
<Subject 4> is the long flexible practice staff with a yellow shaft and red tassel from <Video 1>, including its length, bending motion, rotation, speed, direction, and tassel movement.
<Video 1> is the source video whose first eight seconds provide the exact shot order, camera framing, camera movement, choreography, timing, and environment.
<Picture 1> is the character reference image for <Subject 1>.
<Audio 1> is the synchronized original audio track of <Video 1>, reused from 00:00.000 to 00:08.000.

summary:
[video editing + reference generation + audio reuse] The target video is an edited version of the first eight seconds of <Video 1>. Replace the original female performer with exactly one <Subject 1>, using <Picture 1> for identity and appearance while preserving the source performer's frame-by-frame movement, staff choreography, facial-expression timing, camera framing, cuts, pacing, courtyard, and original synchronized audio. Do not redesign, simplify, speed up, slow down, or invent martial-arts movements.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2], [Shot 3], [Shot 4], [Shot 5]): attribute_transfer - the Tom character identity, colors, facial construction, proportions, and 2D cel-animated style are transferred onto the original performer's exact motion.
<Subject 2> (motion source in all shots): partially_preserved - preserve the full body choreography, head movement, gaze direction, expression timing, staff motion, balance, and pose transitions while replacing the visible human with <Subject 1>.
<Subject 3> (appears throughout): fully_preserved - retain the courtyard architecture, stone ground, bonsai, roofline, windows, perspective, and overcast daylight.
<Subject 4> (appears throughout): fully_preserved - retain the staff length, yellow shaft, red tassel, trajectory, rotation, bending, and motion timing.
<Video 1> (first eight seconds): fully_preserved - preserve the original shot order, cuts, camera framing, pacing, and movement timing.
<Picture 1>: fully_preserved - preserve the recognizable Tom identity and character design.
<Audio 1>: fully_copy - reuse the synchronized original audio from 00:00.000 to 00:08.000.

detailed_description:
The target is a vertical 9:16 mixed-media video. A 2D cel-animated Tom-like cat is composited into the live-action courtyard of <Video 1>. Preserve the original camera perspective, lighting direction, background depth, motion blur, cuts, and timing. Exactly one instance of <Subject 1> is visible in the frame. <Subject 1> remains one single physical character with one continuous complete body throughout the segment. No duplicate, clone, twin, doppelganger, extra copy, lookalike, ghost image, afterimage, motion trail, split body, or suddenly appearing extra character.

[Shot 1] The frame begins with the empty courtyard from <Subject 3>. The white wall, carved dark roof detail, bonsai, stone railing, and grey paving remain unchanged. From approximately 00:00.70 to 00:01.00, <Subject 1> enters from the right edge while carrying <Subject 4>. Preserve the original entrance speed, torso angle, arm position, staff angle, and screen placement.

[Shot 2] From approximately 00:01.00 to 00:03.20, use the same chest-up framing as <Video 1>. <Subject 1> first looks slightly downward, then slowly raises the head and faces forward. The gaze briefly shifts toward screen-right. The expression remains calm, serious, and focused, with relaxed eyebrows, closed mouth, stable ears, and subtle whisker movement. Do not add a smile or exaggerated cartoon expression. Keep <Subject 4> visible behind the shoulder at the same diagonal angle.

[Shot 3] At approximately 00:03.20, cut to the wide full-body shot. <Subject 1> raises <Subject 4> above the head, rotates the torso, and steps toward screen-right. Preserve the original hand spacing, elbow angles, shoulder rotation, foot placement, staff arc, red-tassel movement, and weight transfer.

[Shot 4] From approximately 00:04.00 to 00:06.80, <Subject 1> continues the staff sequence and lowers into a deep rightward lunge. The front knee bends deeply, the rear leg extends behind, the torso leans forward, and the staff sweeps horizontally toward screen-right. Preserve the original speed, balance, staff direction, and low center of gravity.

[Shot 5] From approximately 00:06.80 to 00:08.000, <Subject 1> continues the horizontal staff sweep, rises partially, lifts the staff upward, and turns the torso away from the camera. End near the same rear three-quarter pose as the source video, with the arms extended and the staff continuing through the upper part of the frame. Match the source video's final body position, camera framing, staff direction, and background composition at 00:08.000.

overall_soundscape:
<Audio 1> is directly reused from 00:00.000 to 00:08.000, including the original courtyard ambience, staff movement sounds, footstep sounds, cloth movement, and synchronized physical sounds.

non_diegetic_music:
Reuse any audience-only music from <Audio 1> with the original timing. Do not add new music.

properties.text:
这个是搬运的工作流
工作流原作者链接：https://www.runninghub.cn/post/2109907990638850050，可以关注下

怎么写提示词：
第一步发给AI：https://github.com/MiniMax-AI/MiniMax-H3 --skill h3-prompt-writing，帮我安装这个skill；
第二步：把素材拖个AI，请帮我调用这个skill,写提示词，做人物替换，要非常精准的描述动作，和复刻表情，要起*****

找学习搭子、共享资源的，欢迎加微信～
图片、音频、视频、代码、办公写作、研报方案、副业、自媒体运营等资源都可以一起交流分享，彼此启发，共同进步。

不卖课、不提供答疑，倡导自主学习；同频的朋友欢迎来聊。

一切不会，截图给豆包！截图给豆包！
